difficulty_reason: Perfectoidness of the generic modular curve does not establish the asserted integral formal model or identify the completed affine rings with their power-bounded subrings. The author analyzes the ordinary, supersingular and cusp transition rings, proves Frobenius surjectivity after completed-local faithfully flat descent, and verifies integral closure and the cyclotomic structural map. Those integral calculations are the remaining obligation before tilde-limit uniqueness identifies the generic fibre.
